# Wharf 0.9.0 research

## Scope

Session 9 executes one prepared task in an isolated agent environment and
retains a complete, durable result without exposing verifier-only material.

## Decisions

- Keep execution behind `IAgentRunner`, with `DockerAgentRunner` as the
  production boundary and a fake runner for deterministic tests.
- Require distinct absolute source and agent-workspace directories and reject
  hidden material located within either mount.
- Run containers as an unprivileged UID with explicit source/workspace mounts
  and a named network.
- Persist stdout, stderr, trajectory, patch, timing, usage, and a versioned
  result summary.
- Treat an empty patch as `unfinished` and retain all evidence before raising
  an explicit error.

## Deferred

Verifier execution, patch application, and multi-task scheduling remain later
session work.
